issues.explanation: In 妻と御三, と coordinates the two agents and means “and,” not “with.”
In 妻と御三に勧められても, に marks the passive agents and means “by,” not “to.”
The surface 拒ん is read こばん, not こばま.

issues.segment_text: 声 / を / かけ / た
issues.explanation: 声をかける is a genuine fixed expression meaning “to call out to,” so it should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Use one word segment with surface "声をかけた", lemma "声をかける", kana "こえをかけた", and meaning "called out to".

issues.explanation: Here ても expresses concession: the master refused even though he was urged. “Even when” is less accurate in this context.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en "even though he was urged/recommended it".

issues.explanation: In 牛乳だけでは眠れず, ず is a negative continuative meaning “unable to sleep and…”; “without” is too vague.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en "being unable to sleep; unable to sleep and …".

issues.explanation: This segment is not present in TEXT, so the segment surfaces do not concatenate exactly to TEXT.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the final newline punctuation segment.
